## Summary

Describe the feature in one or two sentences.

## Motivation

What problem does this solve? Who would benefit and how often?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the expected input and output. If it is a new base image or framework, include:

- Detection pattern (image name, CMD keyword, etc.)
- Recommended health check command
- Suggested `/health` endpoint snippet (if applicable)

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you evaluated and why you prefer this one.
